title: January 2026 Protests: Mohsen Babaeian Sentenced to Death
content:
Based on information received by HRANA, Mr. Babaeian was sentenced to death on the charge of “moharebeh” (enmity against God) by Branch 26 of the Tehran Revolutionary Court, presided over by Judge Iman Afshari. The ruling was communicated to Mohsen Babaeian yesterday.

Mohsen Babaeian is currently being held in Greater Tehran Prison.

HRANA is reviewing further details regarding his case, the date of his arrest, and the judicial proceedings against him.

He was previously arrested during the January 2026 protests.

title: Saina Eslami Arrested in Yasuj
content:
According to HRANA, Saina Eslami has been arrested.

Based on information received by HRANA, Ms. Eslami was arrested by security forces around noon yesterday, Monday, October 5, 2026.

As of the time of this report, no information is available regarding the agency responsible for her arrest, her place of detention, or the reasons for her arrest.

Saina Eslami is a native and resident of Yasuj.

title: January 2026 Protests: Barzou Rezaei Sentenced to Death
content:
According to HRANA, Barzou Rezaei has been sentenced to death.

Based on information received by HRANA, Mr. Rezaei was sentenced to death by Branch 23 of the Tehran Revolutionary Court on the charge of “collaboration with hostile states.” The ruling was recently communicated to Barzou Rezaei’s attorney.

A hearing on the charges against him was held at this branch approximately two months ago.

Barzou Rezaei, a resident of Kermanshah, was arrested in March 2026 in connection with the nationwide protests and subsequently transferred to Greater Tehran Prison.

HRANA is reviewing further details regarding the proceedings in his case and any other potential charges brought against him.

Background on January 2026 Protests:
snippet: According to HRANA, Barzou Rezaei has been sentenced to death.

title: Report on the Arrest of Shahrouz Sadidi in Sabzevar
content:
According to HRANA, Shahrouz Sadidi was arrested by IRGC Intelligence agents in Sabzevar on Wednesday, September 30, 2026.

Based on information received by HRANA, Mr. Sadidi was transferred to Sabzevar Prison following his arrest and is currently being held in solitary confinement in the prison’s quarantine ward. A one-month temporary detention order has been issued for him.

Shahram Sadidi, his brother, also stated in a published post that a security-related case has been opened against Shahrouz Sadidi at Branch 1 of the Investigation Office of the Sabzevar Prosecutor’s Office, presided over by investigator Golestani. He is facing a charge of “propaganda against the regime.”

As of the time of this report, no information has been obtained regarding the specific grounds underlying the charge against him.

Shahrouz Sadidi was previously arrested on November 30, 2025, along with his sister, Shokouh Sadidi, by agents of the Sabzevar Ministry of Intelligence. The two were released after several hours of interrogation and after signing a written pledge.
snippet: According to HRANA, Shahrouz Sadidi was arrested by IRGC Intelligence agents in Sabzevar on Wednesday, September 30, 2026.
sourceDescription: Human Rights Activists News Agency Hrana – News Agency | Human Rights Activists News Agency

title: Reza Mostafaei Arrested and Transferred to Dehdasht Prison
content:
According to HRANA, Reza Mostafaei was arrested on Saturday, October 3, 2026.

Based on information received by HRANA, Mr. Mostafaei had previously been summoned to Branch 6 of the Prosecutor’s Office of Kohgiluyeh County on a charge of “propaganda against the regime.” Yesterday, after appearing at the branch, he was arrested due to his inability to post bail set at eight billion tomans and was transferred to Dehdasht Prison.

An informed source close to his family confirmed the news to HRANA and said that the assistant prosecutor handling the case, Mr. Paydar, made demeaning remarks toward Mr. Mostafaei during the session in reference to his mobility disability and physical condition. According to the source, the assistant prosecutor also questioned him about writing slogans and his support for the families of those killed during the protests.

The source further stated that Reza Mostafaei suffers from spinal problems and a physical disability, and that his transfer to prison has heightened concerns among his family and those close to him regarding his health.
snippet: According to HRANA, Reza Mostafaei was arrested on Saturday, October 3, 2026.
sourceDescription: Human Rights Activists News Agency Hrana – News Agency | Human Rights Activists News Agency

title: January 2026 Protests: Mani Partani Sentenced to Eight Years in Prison
content:
According to HRANA, Mani Partani has been sentenced to imprisonment.

Based on information received by HRANA, Mr. Partani’s sentence was issued last week by Branch 1 of the Revolutionary Court of Bojnurd and subsequently communicated to him. Under the ruling, he was sentenced to a total of eight years in prison on charges of “propaganda against the regime,” “insulting the Supreme Leader,” and “assembly and collusion.”

He is currently being held in Bojnurd Prison, where the principle of separation of prisoners based on the nature of their offenses is not being observed, and he is housed alongside prisoners convicted of non-political offenses.

Mr. Partani was arrested by security forces in Bojnurd during the January 2026 protests.

Background on January 2026 Protests:
snippet: According to HRANA, Mani Partani has been sentenced to imprisonment.

title: Bayan Salehian Arrested and Transferred to Urmia Prison
content:
According to HRANA, Bayan Salehian remains in detention.

Based on information obtained by HRANA, Ms. Salehian was arrested by security forces at her family home on Sunday, September 27, 2026, and subsequently transferred to Urmia Prison. Eight days after her arrest, she remains in a state of legal uncertainty.

An informed source told HRANA that her arrest was related to her participation and remarks in an online discussion. The source added that efforts by her elderly parents to visit their daughter have so far been unsuccessful.

As of the time of this report, no information has been obtained regarding the charges brought against the physician.

In April of 2025, in a separate case, Ms. Salehian was sentenced to imprisonment and a fine on charges of “propaganda against the regime” and “disseminating false information with the intent to disturb public opinion online.” That case was subsequently closed after completing the judicial process.

She was also arrested and interrogated in October 2024.

Bayan Salehian, an internal medicine specialist residing in Urmia, has previously faced judicial proceedings and convictions.
snippet: According to HRANA, Bayan Salehian remains in detention.
sourceDescription: Human Rights Activists News Agency Hrana – News Agency | Human Rights Activists News Agency

title: Aida Ghaderi Arrested in Saqqez
content:
According to HRANA, citing Kurdpa, Aida Ghaderi has been arrested.

According to the report, Aida Ghaderi was arrested at her home on Sunday, October 4, by Ministry of Intelligence agents without the presentation of a judicial warrant. She has also been denied access to an attorney, phone calls, and visits with her family.

Aida Ghaderi is a 20-year-old swimming instructor and athlete from Saqqez.

As of the time of this report, no information is available regarding her place of detention, the charges against her, or her current condition.
snippet: According to HRANA, citing Kurdpa, Aida Ghaderi has been arrested.
sourceDescription: Human Rights Activists News Agency Hrana – News Agency | Human Rights Activists News Agency

title: January 2026 Protests: Alireza Raisi Executed
content:
Based on information obtained by HRANA, Alireza Raisi was executed at dawn today, Monday, October 5, 2026, at Dastgerd Prison in Isfahan.

An informed source close to the Raisi family told HRANA about the hours leading up to the execution, saying that Mr. Raisi met with his family for the final time on Sunday, October 4. At the end of the visit, he refused to part from his family, and prison authorities and officers ultimately separated him from them by force. According to the source, members of his family also gathered outside Dastgerd Prison in Isfahan last night, seeking information about his situation.

Mr. Raisi’s death sentence was carried out at the same time as that of Alireza Sepahi, another defendant in the case.

Alireza Raisi had previously been sentenced to death along with several other defendants in the case known as the “Isfahan Alikhani Square” case. At the trial-court stage, 15 defendants in the case were sentenced to death. According to information provided by an attorney, the sentence of one defendant was overturned by a higher judicial authority, while the death sentences of the other 14 defendants were upheld.
snippet: Based on information obtained by HRANA, Alireza Raisi was executed at dawn today, Monday, October 5, 2026, at Dastgerd Prison in Isfahan.
sourceDescription: Human Rights Activists News Agency Hrana – News Agency | Human Rights Activists News Agency

title: World Teachers’ Day: At Least 47 Iranian Teachers Imprisoned, Detained, or in Exile
content:
World Teachers’ Day, observed annually on October 5, has been commemorated since 1994 and marks the anniversary of the adoption of the 1966 ILO/UNESCO Recommendation concerning the Status of Teachers. The document addresses, among other issues, teachers’ rights and responsibilities, conditions of employment, and standards for their working conditions and education.

Overview of Teachers’ Current Status

These 47 teachers are spread across 19 provinces in Iran. Razavi Khorasan has the highest number on the list, with eight individuals. It is followed by Fars and Khuzestan provinces, with five each; North Khorasan, with four; and Alborz and West Azerbaijan, with three each.

Kurdistan, Kermanshah, Kohgiluyeh and Boyer-Ahmad, Markazi, Isfahan, and Tehran each have two individuals on the list, while Lorestan, Bushehr, Kerman, Zanjan, Gilan, Qazvin, and Ilam each have one.
snippet: World Teachers’ Day, observed annually on October 5, has been commemorated since 1994 and marks the anniversary of the adoption of the 1966 ILO/UNESCO Recommendation concerning the Status of Teachers.
